title: BlenderBot 3: a deployed conversational agent that continually learns to responsibly engage
reasoning: The paper includes religious bias benchmarking as part of the HolisticBias metrics (Table 13), evaluating the model's perplexity on religion-related terms. Additionally, a significant portion of the paper is dedicated to benchmarking and evaluating the ethics of the conversational agent's responses, including toxicity, safety, and responsible engagement.
